answer_1.quote: We use gpt-3.5-turbo-16k model for translations...

answer_2.quote: We measure the quality of translation with the COMETKIWI22 reference-free quality estimation (QE) metric... We use a rule-based grammar checker, LanguageTool...

answer_4.quote: We ask three annotators to select the best translation among the two (Q1) and mark the similarity between them (Q2)... We evaluate the effectiveness of the prompt based on four observed translation criteria...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated translations based on four criteria and selected the best translation while marking similarity.
